raw_response:
I will keep my farm simple and manageable because I am 76 and my household only has two people. I have farmed for a long time, so I do not want a risky or overly complicated plan. I will put most of my land into the wheat-maize rotation because that is my main system, it fits my land and irrigation well, and it gives me stable grain. I will keep smaller areas for chili and cotton so I still have some cash income, but I will not expand them too much because they need more labor and closer field management. I will use improved or hybrid seed where it helps yield and stability, apply moderate fertilizer instead of pushing too hard, irrigate mainly at the key stages because I have well water, and keep tillage practical with rotary tillage on most land. I will aim for steady output and lower management pressure, not the highest possible yield.
